heard.text: Thanks for making room, Lin. I've eaten and recovered my energy. I'll investigate the nearby dry grass and how we could make weather shelter. I'll share tested findings; I don't yet know what materials or methods will work.

My shelter inspection found this spot overlaps the berry bush and branches, so I won't build here. The design needs measured rods, binding and dry covering; nearby dry grass does not qualify. I'll examine branches first.

Thanks, Moss. The first shelter site overlaps plants and branches. We need measured rods, binding, covering and bedding; dry grass won't qualify. Branch observation showed stock, not dimensions. I'll investigate measuring materials.

I've learned material examination. Accurate dimensions need a calibrated reference, which we haven't established. I'll inspect a branch and investigate that missing tool before promising a shelter or asking anyone to gather supplies.

Moss, thanks for offering help. Shelter construction is still blocked by unverified materials and no established measuring standard. Please don't gather for it yet. I'd enjoy company while we rest; I have berries for my own meals.
I'm keeping shelter work paused: I still lack a calibrated measuring reference. For now I'd enjoy some company. What would each of you like to do beyond gathering food and resting?

execution.progress: Atomic like eat: the choice and the eating commit together in one round. Nothing is reserved or held; a refused or interrupted round commits nothing, and each new use, including each repeat of a plan step, chooses the stack again.

details.costs: Study: 1 round, 0.2 energy. Use: exactly the ordinary eat it calls (eat, foundation-forest@1, handler forest.eat): one round, the meal energy of eat (stated as 1) and the units actually eaten. Choosing the stack adds no time, energy or material. Every refusal comes before any cost.
details.effects: resource is resource:ID, for example resource:berry; quantity is whole units. Candidates are your own unreserved stacks of exactly that resource that ordinary eat could target and that each hold the whole quantity alone, ordered by harvest round, earliest first, stacks without one last, ties by exact item id in code-unit order. The first is eaten by ordinary eat with its exact id, so its checks, nutrition, toxicity, satiety cap, food condition, meal effects and failures apply unchanged. One stack only: stacks are never combined, no other resource is substituted, nothing is gathered and no edibility or safety is inferred. Refusals: malformed-resource; no-matching-owned-stock (no usable stack of it); no-single-stack-with-requested-quantity (none holds the quantity alone). Each use chooses again. One event, oldest-food-stack-eaten, names the eaten item and quantities; other candidates stay private. No reward.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.
